snippet.title: Share Your Lunch! 🥪 Food for Two Is Enough for Three | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Uh oh! My friend forgot his lunch today. But my lunch is only for me... or is it?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) taught us: food for two is enough for three, and food for three is enough for four!

So I break my sandwich in half: one half for me, and one half for you! Then another friend sits down and we share the apple slices too. Everybody has enough, and everybody is smiling. When we share, there is blessing (barakah) in our food. It feels like more, not less! Who will you share with tomorrow? Tell your grown-up!

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 5392 (narrated by Hazrat Abu Huraira, Radi Allahu Anhu): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:5392

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only ordinary children and a mum are drawn.
